name: Kazama Mika
source:
He is always foul-mouthed and abrupt. He's putting up a bravado to hide his character and has a friendly side. Ever since he was younger he's acted cold to his genius older brother, Niki.

Kaito is his childhood friend who he can share anything with. Sometimes he gets really depressed by Rin's sharp-tongued words.

Sign: Leo
Likes: Soccer, grandma's cooking
Dislikes: Insects
Power: Wind

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character/]official website[/url]]
